settings.personaDescEmma: Friendly US coach who makes English practice stress-free and fun.
settings.personaDescArthur: Oxford RP British mentor emphasizing pronunciation and grammar nuance.
settings.personaDescAlex: Energetic conversation coach specialized in idioms, slang, and banter.
settings.personaDescShanya: Lively Erbil/Hawler tutor specialized in rapid conversational drills and everyday colloquial expressions.
settings.personaDescTanya: Cultured Sulaymaniyah educator renowned for literary precision, phonetics, and elegant sentence structure.
settings.personaDescLanah: Nurturing elder sister who patiently removes speaking anxiety and builds beginner confidence step-by-step.
settings.personaDescViyan: Expressive cultural tutor who bridges target language idioms with traditional Kurdish proverbs.
settings.personaDescRojin: Sharp career coach specializing in professional fluency, presentations, and assertive delivery.
settings.personaDescRebwar: Native Kurdish mentor who bridges Kurdish and English with patient analogies.
settings.personaDescDilar: Supportive Kurdish tutor dedicated to building speaking confidence.
settings.personaDescAso: Lively Kurdish coach connecting learners to modern idioms and spoken speed.
settings.personaDescHewa: Calm, thoughtful mentor creating a relaxed environment for deep conversation and life reflection.
settings.personaDescZayd: Bilingual Arabic coach providing articulate phonetics and grammar clarity.
settings.personaDescLayla: Warm Arabic tutor encouraging natural speaking and expressive vocabulary.
settings.personaDescKarim: Vibrant coach focused on real-world situations, travel, and workplace English.
settings.personaDescMateo: Cheerful bilingual tutor bringing rhythmic Latin warmth to your practice.
settings.personaDescSofia: Global polyglot mentor specialized in neutral enunciation and phonetics.
settings.personaDescStatesman: An original, confident public-speaking voice with deliberate pacing and emphatic delivery—not a celebrity imitation.
settings.personaDescDocumentary: An original cinematic narrator who makes explanations vivid, measured, and memorable.
settings.personaDescBroadcaster: An original deep radio voice with crisp articulation, calm authority, and polished rhythm.
